entries.zh: 停留在某处、居留（字头作「對」，稿音 Tui，疑借同音字记「住留」义）；「對」另有相对、正确义
entries.en: to stay / remain in a place (head char. 對 tui; the character itself means 'correct, opposite' — stay sense likely a homophone write)
entries.notes: 「對」本义与西语词头 quedarse en alguna parte 不合，疑同音借写；第 2 位为其圈选重写件

entries.zh: 帶（蹛）：停留在某处、住；配「守帶」则指守候等待
entries.en: to stay in a place, to dwell (帶, written for the stay/dwell word); cf. 守帶 'to wait, keep standing by'

entries.zh: 侵吞他人之物、将他人财物据为己有（首字〔疑：蜀/溺〕，音 leg）
entries.en: to keep / retake what belongs to another (character uncertain; gloss uncertain)
entries.notes: 首字难辨，且闽南语词与 quedarse con lo ajeno 之对应无法确证，仅据西语词头拟译

entries.zh: 刻亏（剋虧）：占人便宜、亏待人，使人吃亏
entries.en: to wrong someone / take advantage of them, to cheat; to keep another's goods to their loss
entries.notes: M 栏音注污损（T99）、R 空栏，词头内亦有缺损词（lo pebr 疑有误读），据汉字「刻虧」拟译

entries.zh: 克亏：亏待人、占人便宜（使人吃亏）
entries.en: to wrong someone / take advantage of them (克虧, circled rewrite of the preceding entry)
entries.notes: 第 4 位之圈选重写件（选定字「克」），M 音注仍污损（T99）、R 空栏

entries.zh: 押冬：滞留异乡、客居他邦一时
entries.en: to stay / sojourn some time in a foreign land (押冬)
entries.notes: R 空栏；「押」取留押滞留义、「冬」指时日/冬，据西语词头推定

entries.zh: 守带（守蹛）：守候、等候
entries.en: to wait, to keep waiting / standing by (守帶)

entries.zh: 面冷：惊呆、发愣（面如冻僵）；词头例：所盼王上之事应验而惊住
entries.en: to be stunned / frozen up (lit. the face turns cold); example: stupefied when what one had hoped from the king came about
entries.notes: R 栏 bin chin 与「面冷」对音不合（疑另有字），词头 elado 疑为 helado 之讹，据 H/M 拟译

entries.zh: 留在此处、待在这里（首字〔疑：晉/徛〕，配「放處」，音 tau pang te）
entries.en: stay here! (imperative); to remain in this place
entries.notes: 首字难辨、音节与字序对应未尽吻合，据西语词头 quedate aquí 拟译

entries.zh: 做味：做样子、使暗号（「这是什么」猜谜问句下的示意）；亦摆架子
entries.en: 'What is it, and what?' — call in a guessing game; 做味 = to make signs / give hints
entries.notes: 词头为游戏问句（ques cosa y cosa），与「做味」的义项搭配依赖推断

entries.zh: 装扮（字头作「創辨」，音 chong pan，疑即「妝扮」）：假扮、扮相示人；旁注「或猜(adiuinar)」
entries.en: to disguise oneself / dress up (in the guessing game 'what is it?'); interlinear note: 'or to guess (adivinar)'
entries.notes: 「創辨」与词头对应无法确证，疑为「妝扮」同音，语义无法定夺

entries.zh: 投：投诉、控告（投告）；亦投奔依托
entries.en: to complain / lodge a complaint, to sue (投告)
entries.notes: M 栏音注污损（T99）；「投」取投告、投诉义（与第 16 位「投告」条互证）

entries.zh: 伸（伸冤）：诉冤、向王上或官府申诉冤屈
entries.en: to complain of injustice to the king, to seek redress (伸冤)

entries.zh: 伸告：申诉、控告（向王上陈告冤屈）
entries.en: to complain to the king, to lodge a grievance (伸告)

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕呻吟、病中诉苦（音 chan）
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕 to moan / complain in sickness (of the sick person)
entries.notes: 汉字栏残缺，据 M 音 chan 与词头 quejarse con el enfermo 拟为「呻」义

entries.zh: 投告（陈告）：申诉、告状
entries.en: to complain, to lodge a complaint / bring a suit (投告; manuscript sound suggests 陳告)
entries.notes: M 音 tan 与「投」常读不合，疑首字实为「陳」，依赖推断

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕乱乱呻（第二字残）：絮聒诉苦、接连抱怨
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕 to complain much / grumble on and on
entries.notes: 中字残缺，末字「孱」疑为「呻」，据 M 音 loan loan chan 拟译

entries.zh: 哀告：哀求、悲诉（含悲申诉）
entries.en: to lament and plead, to complain with sorrow (哀告)

entries.zh: 吐气：叹气、唉声诉苦
entries.en: to sigh, to complain amid sighs (吐氣)

entries.zh: 叫苦（首字〔疑：叫/咎〕）：叫苦、诉苦（叹命运多舛或病中叫苦）
entries.en: to cry out one's hardship, to complain of one's lot or in sickness (叫苦)
entries.notes: 首字难辨，据音 quio 与词头取「叫苦」义
